description: This file defines the interface 'ShufflePartitionWriter' used in Apache Spark for writing partition data to a backing data store during shuffle operations. It includes methods for opening output streams and channels, and tracking bytes written.

classes.name: ShufflePartitionWriter
classes.description: Interface for writing shuffle partition data, providing methods to open streams and channels, and report bytes written.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens an OutputStream to write bytes to the data store for a partition.

methods.name: openChannelWrapper
methods.description: Opens a WritableByteChannelWrapper for optimized byte transfer; defaults to empty.

methods.name: getNumBytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes written through the stream or channel.
